cc_prospect.description: A potential customer who has been identified but not yet qualified or converted. Represents the earliest stage of the customer acquisition lifecycle.

senses.description: An unqualified contact record in the CRM system, sourced from marketing campaigns, referrals, or territory prospecting.
A business entity within a target market segment that matches the ideal customer profile for water filtration solutions.

cc_prospect.provenance: Extracted from PureTec VCC scaffold — Lead-to-Customer value stream, stages 1-3
cc_prospect.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query Salesforce Lead object WHERE Status IN ('New', 'Working') AND Territory = {agent.territory}

cc_customer.description: An entity that has contracted with PureTec for water filtration products and services. A customer exists across multiple value streams with different operational meanings.

senses.description: A converted account record in Salesforce CRM with active opportunity or closed-won deal.
An entity with installed equipment requiring scheduled maintenance, cartridge replacement, and technical support.
A billing entity with active purchase orders, delivery addresses, and payment terms.

cc_customer.provenance: Extracted from PureTec VCC scaffold — spans Lead-to-Customer, Order-to-Delivery, and Install-to-Maintenance value streams
cc_customer.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query Salesforce Account WHERE Type = 'Customer' AND Id = {case.accountId}; UNION NetSuite Customer WHERE ExternalId = {case.accountId}

cc_territory.description: A geographic or account-based boundary that governs sales representative assignment, prospect ownership, and performance accountability.

senses.description: A defined geographic region with assigned sales representative, quota targets, and prospect pool.
A geographic zone determining which service technicians are dispatched for installations and maintenance.

cc_territory.provenance: Extracted from PureTec VCC scaffold — Territory-to-Performance value stream

cc_cartridge.description: A consumable component in PureTec water filtration systems that requires periodic replacement according to manufacturer specifications and water quality conditions.

senses.description: An inventory item with part number, compatibility matrix, and warehouse stock levels.
A service-triggering component whose replacement schedule drives preventive maintenance workflows.

cc_cartridge.provenance: Extracted from PureTec VCC scaffold — Install-to-Maintenance and Order-to-Delivery value streams

cc_water_quality_report.description: A diagnostic assessment of water quality metrics at a customer installation site, used to determine filtration requirements and maintenance scheduling.

senses.description: Pre-installation water analysis determining system configuration and cartridge type.
Periodic water quality check validating cartridge effectiveness and identifying replacement timing.

cc_water_quality_report.provenance: Extracted from PureTec VCC scaffold — Install-to-Maintenance value stream

cc_maintenance_schedule.description: A governed timetable of preventive maintenance activities for installed water filtration systems, including cartridge replacements, site inspections, and system calibrations.

senses.description: A time-bound schedule of upcoming service visits, technician assignments, and required parts.
A tracked record of maintenance commitments vs actuals, used for SLA reporting and customer satisfaction.

cc_maintenance_schedule.provenance: Extracted from PureTec VCC scaffold — Install-to-Maintenance value stream

pc_territory_compliance.name: Territory Assignment Compliance
pc_territory_compliance.description: All prospect engagement must occur within the sales representative's assigned territory boundaries. Cross-territory engagement requires explicit management approval.

outcomes.description: Verify territory assignment before initiating prospect engagement
Engage prospects outside assigned territory without Sales Manager approval
Log all prospect interactions in CRM within 24 hours

exceptions: VP-level override for strategic accounts exceeding $500K ARR potential
Cross-territory referral with originating rep's consent
pc_territory_compliance.provenance: PureTec Sales Operations Policy Manual, Section 3.2 — Territory Governance

pc_data_privacy.name: Customer Data Privacy and Consent
pc_data_privacy.description: Customer personal and operational data must be handled in accordance with privacy regulations. Sharing with third parties requires explicit documented consent.

outcomes.description: Share customer PII with external parties without documented consent
Record consent evidence in customer record before data transfer
Apply data minimisation — share only fields required for stated purpose

exceptions: Regulatory disclosure mandated by law enforcement with valid warrant
pc_data_privacy.provenance: PureTec Data Governance Policy, Section 7.1 — Privacy Obligations

pc_maintenance_sla.name: Maintenance SLA Compliance
pc_maintenance_sla.description: Preventive maintenance visits must be scheduled and executed within contracted SLA windows. Customers must receive advance notification before scheduled maintenance.

outcomes.description: Send customer notification 14 days before scheduled cartridge replacement
Confirm parts availability before scheduling service visit
Escalate overdue maintenance to Service Manager within 48 hours

pc_maintenance_sla.provenance: PureTec Service Level Agreement Template, Clause 4.3 — Preventive Maintenance

pc_escalation_policy.name: Agent Escalation Protocol
pc_escalation_policy.description: When an agent cannot resolve a customer interaction within defined boundaries, mandatory escalation to a human operator must occur. This policy implements the 'human above the loop' governance pattern.

outcomes.description: Escalate to human operator after 2 unsuccessful resolution attempts
Transfer full interaction context including MVC working set to human operator
Offer discounts, credits, or contract modifications exceeding agent authority limit
Log escalation reason, context state, and proposed action in decision trace

exceptions: Pre-approved automated responses for known FAQ patterns
Scheduled callback where customer explicitly accepts delay
pc_escalation_policy.provenance: PureTec Customer Operations Governance Manual, Section 9.1 — Agent Autonomy Boundaries
